categories.main_business_segments: OurPalm Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the development, publishing, and operation of online games, with a focus on mobile games. The company operates globally, offering products such as MMORPGs, card games, strategy games (SLG), and mini-games. It also invests in game-related equity and holds subsidiaries involved in game development and publishing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced game development technologies including the Unreal Engine for high-quality graphics and immersive experiences. It integrates AI technologies for game design, modeling, and content innovation. The production methods emphasize globalized R&D, localized publishing, and continuous iteration of game versions to extend product lifecycles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: OurPalm serves a broad customer base including individual gamers across China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Its key markets are mobile and online gaming users, with products distributed via platforms like Apple Store and Android markets. The company also collaborates with major third-party operators such as Tencent and Webzen.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in domestic Chinese markets and internationally in regions including Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, Singapore, and other Southeast Asian countries. It has established subsidiaries in these locations to support localized development and publishing efforts.
categories.supply_chain_position: OurPalm operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the gaming supply chain, focusing on game development, publishing, and operation. It also holds equity investments upstream in related technology and content providers, enhancing its industry integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustainable development through integrated R&D and operations, focusing on high-quality game production and global market expansion. It actively develops SLG and mini-game genres, accelerates new game launches, and explores AI applications to enhance game innovation and user experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly generated through direct sales of virtual game items and in-game currency via a freemium model, including consumable and permanent virtual goods. The company also earns income from licensing, joint operations, and equity investments. Sales are predominantly conducted online through digital distribution platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OurPalm is positioned as a leading globalized Chinese game company with strong R&D and publishing capabilities. It competes with major domestic and international game developers and publishers, leveraging premium IPs and diversified product portfolios to maintain competitive advantages in MMORPG, card, and strategy game segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 818.7 million, a 16.61% decrease from the previous year, and net profits attributable to shareholders of RMB 110.9 million, down 40.68%. Despite revenue declines due to product lifecycle effects and delayed SLG game launches, the company maintains a solid asset base exceeding RMB 5.3 billion and continues investing significantly in R&D (over 32% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OurPalm emphasizes its strong global R&D and publishing integration, premium IP portfolio, and diversified game offerings across multiple genres and platforms. Its competitive differentiation lies in delivering high-quality, immersive gaming experiences using advanced technologies like Unreal Engine and AI, combined with localized operations and continuous product iteration to maximize user engagement and lifecycle value.
